plugin.name: layout-manager
plugin._long: Global layout mode switching: sway-style H/V tiling <-> stacking (native floating), with per-view float. Runtime switching via keybinding and IPC.

option.name: default_mode
option._long: Layout mode at plugin load: "stacking" (native floating) or "tiling".

option.name: default_orientation
option._long: Split direction of each workspace's tiling root: "auto" (vertical root when the workarea is taller than wide, horizontal otherwise — sway semantics), "h" or "v".

option.name: gaps_inner
option._long: Gaps between tiled views, per side: the visual gap between two neighbors is 2x this value. Only applies in tiling mode.

option.name: gaps_outer
option._long: Gap between the tiled views and the edges of the workarea. Only applies in tiling mode.

option.name: key_toggle_mode
option._long: Toggles the global layout mode between tiling and stacking.

option.name: key_toggle_float
option._long: Floats/unfloats the focused view within tiling mode (sway floating toggle).

option.name: key_split_horizontal
option._long: Wraps the focused tiling view in a horizontal split (new views inserted there are laid out side by side).

option.name: key_split_vertical
option._long: Wraps the focused tiling view in a vertical split.

option.name: key_focus_left
option._long: Moves keyboard focus to the tiled view on the left. Unbound by default.

option.name: key_focus_right
option._long: Moves keyboard focus to the tiled view on the right. Unbound by default.

option.name: key_focus_above
option._long: Moves keyboard focus to the tiled view above. Unbound by default.

option.name: key_focus_below
option._long: Moves keyboard focus to the tiled view below. Unbound by default.

option.name: float_by_default
option._long: View matcher expression; matching views are never tiled and open floating (e.g. "type=dialog"). Empty = no auto-float rules.
